required_content.problem: Behavioral tests can reveal what a model did without identifying the internal features, circuits, representations, or causal pathways that produced it, while interpretability methods can themselves generate persuasive but unstable stories. A probe, visualization, sparse feature label, attribution map, or circuit diagram is not white-box proof unless it is reproducible, causally tested, stable under relevant transformations, scoped to a model/version/data regime, and compared with plausible alternative explanations.
required_content.core_mechanism: Internal-state observations should enter governance only as typed evidence artifacts with lineage, method assumptions, replication status, causal interventions, stability checks, coverage limits, and explicit non-authority; white-box evidence complements but does not replace behavioral and operational evidence. Define an evidence packet containing model hash, dataset slice, method version, feature/circuit identifiers, assumptions, and confidence. Separate observational association, predictive decoding, causal necessity, causal sufficiency, and completeness claims.
required_content.worked_trace: The implemented minimum is a strict internal-evidence packet schema, one explicitly expired record-shape fixture, a separately implemented semantic consumer with twelve rejecting mutations, and a finite Lean route that rejects scientifically incomplete packets, expires changed packets, and cannot grant authority. The claim-bearing campaign is prospectively frozen and resource-isolated but unexecuted; it requires one digest-bound open model, two independently owned methods, a tuned behavioral baseline, positive and negative controls, causal interventions, stability and residual accounting, an independent evaluator, and a one-time held-out opening after seven competence gates. Separate observational association, predictive decoding, causal necessity, causal sufficiency, and completeness claims.
required_content.failure_boundary: feature hallucination confirmation-biased labeling probe leakage polysemantic feature collapse
required_content.evidence_state: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. In the finite policy model, no interpretability evidence packet can widen execution or release authority; it may only preserve, restrict, escalate, or reject. Packets with stale lineage, missing method assumptions, absent negative controls, or unsupported causal state are rejected before governance use. Labels retain examples, counterexamples, and uncertainty.
required_content.non_claims: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.
